title: Marconi Technologies deep-dossier candidate

selectedGap.reason: The operator explicitly requested a deep dossier for a newly identified Canadian defence prime with a broad tactical communications portfolio absent from the live corpus.

guardrailNotes: This run creates one private organization candidate only and does not change published organizations, capabilities, programs, relationships, sources, evidence or taxonomy.
Development-stage products are explicitly labelled; the underspecified Crypto item is excluded, and all mission matches remain derived and reviewable.

candidates.reviewerRationale: Marconi Technologies is recommended for green private review as a newly standalone Canadian defence prime whose inherited but current tactical-communications portfolio is materially important to the map. Official evidence establishes Montréal headquarters, Canadian-majority ownership, three mature product families and a development-stage sensor-fusion platform. Government reporting independently confirms a made-in-Canada Orion contract exceeding C$10 million for Polish Cyber Command. The reviewer should retain the explicit development-stage label for SAMS and leave legalName blank until a registry source resolves the exact Canadian entity.
reviewWarnings: The website footer says Marconi Inc., but this run did not resolve an authoritative corporate-registry record; legalName remains null.
SAMS is explicitly development-stage. The separate Crypto coming-soon item lacks enough technical detail and is not proposed as a capability.

duplicateCheck.note: Live production checks found no published organization or pending candidate matching Marconi Technologies, Marconi, Marconi Inc. or marconi-technologies.com.

fieldEvidence.excerpt: The launch release identifies a standalone, Canadian-majority-owned, veteran-run company headquartered in Montréal and formed through acquisition of Ultra I&C's Tactical Communications division.
The official website lists Marconi's Canadian location at 5990 Côte-de-Liesse, Mont-Royal, Quebec, Canada.
The official portfolio spans tactical radios, troposcatter, tactical SATCOM, sensor and cyber data fusion, and development-stage encryption.
Marconi describes Orion as a high-capacity tactical-radio family with MANET, long-haul and backhaul modes, wideband agility, survivability and AI-assisted spectrum adaptation.
The Prime Minister's Office confirms a contract exceeding C$10 million for made-in-Canada Orion tactical radios for Polish Cyber Command, with deliveries through 2030.
The official Archer material supports beyond-line-of-sight troposcatter connectivity over 200 kilometres without satellites, with rapid setup, auto-alignment, encryption and anti-jamming.
Marconi reports a multi-day FMV evaluation in which Archer maintained a 75-kilometre link and integrated with the Swedish Armed Forces mobile network node.
The official Hunter material supports rapidly deployable tactical SATCOM across multiple bands, constellations and orbits, with a toolless manpack and flyaway posture.
Marconi describes development-stage SAMS as a sensor-agnostic platform that combines sensor and cyber data into a common operational picture with warning and system-health functions.
Marconi identifies Enamor International as its Polish integration partner for multi-year Orion X650 deliveries following in-country trials.
The launch release states that Marconi was formed when a Canadian investor group acquired Ultra I&C's Tactical Communications division from Cobham Ultra.
The Archer trial release identifies Sweden's FMV as the defence materiel authority participating in the June 2026 multi-day evaluation.
The official website publishes sales@marconi-technologies.com and the Montréal, Maryland and United Kingdom operating locations.

organization.name: Marconi Technologies
organization.description: Marconi Technologies is a Canadian-majority-owned, veteran-run defence technology company headquartered in Montréal that develops and manufactures tactical communications and networked mission systems for Canadian and allied users.

profileData.ownershipAndHistory: Launched in May 2026 as a standalone, Canadian-majority-owned company after a Canadian investor group led by Louis Vachon acquired Ultra I&C's Tactical Communications division from Cobham Ultra; the business identifies itself as a descendant of Canadian Marconi Corporation.
profileData.canadianFootprint: Headquartered at 5990 Côte-de-Liesse in Mont-Royal, Quebec, with development and manufacturing operations in Canada and additional locations in Germantown, Maryland and Tring, United Kingdom.
profileData.portfolioScope: Resilient line-of-sight and beyond-line-of-sight tactical communications, high-capacity MANET radios, troposcatter, tactical SATCOM, sensor and cyber data fusion, and development-stage military cryptography.
profileData.currentActivity: Marconi and Enamor International are scheduled to begin multi-year Orion X650 deliveries for Polish Cyber Command in 2026 under a contract exceeding C$10 million; Archer also completed a multi-day Swedish FMV evaluation in June 2026.
profileData.publicContact: Sales inquiries: sales@marconi-technologies.com. Public company and product information: https://marconi-technologies.com/.
profileData.evidenceBoundary: Products, ownership, locations, contract activity and public contacts are source-backed. Mission matches are derived analyst assessments, not procurement eligibility, endorsement, customer interest or classified demand.
